2.ar: الرَّبُّ قُوَّتِي وَنَشِيدِي وَقَدْ صَارَ خَلاصِي، هَذَا هُوَ إِلَهِي فَأُسَبِّحُهُ. وَإِلَهُ أَبِي فَأُعَظِّمُهُ.
2.en:
“The Lord is my strength and my defense;
    he has become my salvation.
He is my God, and I will praise him,
    my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

corrections.current: Therefore I will sing praises to Him

6.ar: يَمِينُكَ يَا رَبُّ مَجِيدَةٌ فِي قُوَّتِهَا. بِيَمِينِكَ يَا رَبُّ تَسْحَقُ الْعَدُوَّ.
6.en:
Your right hand, Lord,
    was majestic in power.
Your right hand, Lord,
    shattered the enemy.

18.en:
“The Lord reigns
    for ever and ever.”
